## reference · kanban board columns cards workflow UX planka

- **Board structure** – Projects contain boards; boards contain ordered lists (columns); lists contain cards (tasks).  
- **Drag‑and‑drop** – Cards can be moved between lists and reordered within a list with a single mouse/touch drag; changes are applied instantly.  
- **Real‑time sync** – All users viewing the same board see card moves, edits, and list changes immediately; no page refresh required.  
- **Card description format** – Card bodies are edited with a built‑in Markdown editor; full Markdown syntax (headings, tables, code blocks, etc.) is rendered in the card view.  
- **Notifications** – Planka can push alerts through **100+** provider integrations (e.g., email, Slack, Discord); each provider can be enabled/disabled per user or per board.  
- **Internationalization** – UI strings are fully translatable; the app ships with multiple language packs and can be extended with custom locale files.  
- **Deployment** – Official Docker image is published on GitHub Container Registry; the image has accumulated **8 M+ pulls**.  
- **Self‑hosting** – The source code is always publicly visible; you may deploy the Docker image or build from source on any infrastructure.  
- **Extensibility** – Custom functionality can be added by modifying the open‑source codebase; no proprietary plugins are required.  
- **Licensing** – Community edition is released under the **Fair Use License** (fair‑code); commercial use can be covered by a **Pro/Enterprise License**.  
- **Security reporting** – Do **not** open public GitHub issues for security bugs; instead email **security@planka.group** privately.  
- **Support channels** – No public email support; use GitHub issues for bugs/feature requests and the official Discord server for community help.  
- **Notes app** – A companion Notes app is in testing: iOS via TestFlight, Windows & Android via a direct download link.  
- **Version badge** – The repository’s `package.json` version is displayed on the project README (automatically updated on each release).  

Sources: https://github.com/plankanban/planka
